app.name: Egebis Seyir
app.tagline: From idea to delivery, with Scrum discipline.

spaces.emptyBody: Start by creating a space for your team.
spaces.emptyBodyNoCreate: Spaces you are added to will appear here.

roleHelp.OWNER: Manages everything; can delete the workspace.
roleHelp.MEMBER: Creates spaces and works in the spaces they belong to.
roleHelp.GUEST: Sees only shared spaces and can comment.

login.title: Sign in to Egebis Seyir
login.subtitle: Continue to your workspace.
login.noAccount: No account? Ask a workspace admin for an invitation; you'll create your account from the link in the invitation email.

setup.title: Set up Egebis Seyir

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a reset link.

reset.title: Set a new password

home.subtitle: What is waiting for you today?

home.favoritesEmpty: Spaces, folders and lists you favorite appear here.

profile.title: Profile

preferences.title: Preferences

webhooks.help: Sends a request to an external address when something happens. “Generic” is signed JSON (X-Scrum-Signature: HMAC-SHA256); for Slack and Teams paste the incoming webhook URL and it arrives as a message.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Links commits and PRs/MRs on GitHub or GitLab to an item when its title or message contains the item key (e.g. MOB-12).
integrations.noAccess: Only workspace administrators can manage integrations.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.copyNow: “{{name}}” created. Enter the address and secret below at the provider; the secret will not be shown again.
integrations.githubSteps: GitHub: repo → Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Put the URL in Payload URL and the secret in Secret; Content type: application/json; events: Pushes and Pull requests.
integrations.gitlabSteps: GitLab: project → Settings → Webhooks. Put the URL in URL and the secret in Secret token; tick Push events and Merge request events.
